provenance.networkBoundary: Loopback OpenAI-compatible SSE; no external network or provider credentials.

metricSemantics.executionPath: Every sample traverses the repository provider, RoleGAgent, LocalActor mailbox, and IActorDispatchPort.
metricSemantics.correctnessEvidence: Evidence is read from committed typed progress/completion events, append ledger, durable readback, and committed publication identities; SDK update counts are not correctness evidence.
metricSemantics.percentiles: Nearest-rank percentiles; with 12 samples p95 and p99 both select the maximum.

coverage.unsupportedReason: Streaming output media is not surfaced by the OpenAI-compatible NyxID route/SDK path.

Reasoning/media are unsupported. MapRequest does not map LLMRequest.Tools and LlmTornado only emits its tool accumulator when request.Tools is non-empty, so this adapter cannot currently surface tool deltas (toolsAdvertisedToUpstream=false).
